title: *Godzilla: Minus Zero* (no spoilers)
contentHtml: This is a morally serious movie (really).  And Ghidorah stars!  The whole thing is about twenty minutes too long, but mostly very good.  And like many in the Godzilla series, it offers extended and instructive commentary on American-Japanese relations, and how the Japanese view them.  Not for everyone, but I am glad I went.
